spans.s:
कोण m. (-णः)
 1. A corner, an angle.
 2. The quill or bow of a lute, a
fiddle-stick, &c.
 3. A drum stick.
 4. A sort of stringed musical
instrument.
 5. The sharp edge of a sword.
 6. A stick, a staff, a
club.
 7. A name of Mangala, the planet

. An intermediate point of the compass.
 E. कुण,
to sound, &c. घञ् aff.

कोणकुण m. (-णः) A bug.
 E. कुण् to cut, affix क, added to कीण the edge
of a sword.

कोणाघात m. (-तः) A mixed sound of several musical instruments “ढक्का-
शतसहस्राणि भेरीशतशतानि च । एकदा यत्र हन्यन्ते कोणाघातः स उच्यते” ।
कोणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) Having a crooked arm: see कुणि.
